about: Protection. Played on a player: cancels every other Intrigue card of its field played on them this crisis, in this wave and later ones. These cards don't cancel each other.
Played on a Minister: Intrigue cards can't replace them this crisis. The Sultan's Ferman still can.
Played on a Minister: replace them with any eligible player you choose, yourself included. The newcomer takes the same seat.
Played on a Minister: the Sultan replaces them with an eligible player of his choice. The newcomer takes the same seat.
Played on another player: when Court ends, secretly see every Intrigue card they played this crisis, and on whom.
Played with no target: secretly look at the top 3 Kader cards and put them back in the same order.
Played on a player: they can't lose Influence this crisis, Decree included.
Played on a player: they lose 1 Influence.
Played on a Minister: if they still hold a seat at the Kader step, you gain 1 Influence when Hizmet is played and lose 1 when Hıyanet is played.
Played on a Minister: after the Kader step, secretly see the card or cards that Minister discarded.
Played on the First Minister: if they still hold the seat at the Kader step, they draw 4 Kader cards instead of 3 and discard 2.
Played on a player: when Court ends, pick one card other players played on them this crisis and secretly learn who played it.
Played on a Minister: if this crisis's Decree falls on them, it gives or takes 2 Influence instead of 1.
Played on another player: they can't play an Intrigue card in the next wave.
